motion.name: camera-frame
motion.purpose: Fits selected components inside the viewport. Reduced motion shows the final position immediately.

behavior: When no component, flow, or sequence is selected, All shows all flow lines.
Structure shows no flow lines after a component selection.
Other layers show only flow lines that connect to the selected component. These flow lines keep their usual width.
Without a preview, a selected flow or the selected sequence step shows only its flow line.
The map shows a flow label only for the selected flow or a preview. Use the pointer or keyboard focus for a flow preview.
The same label rule applies when All shows all flow lines.
The inspector shows all connections of the selected component in a flow list. The list has groups for the flow layers and horizontal rows.
Each group shows its layer. Each row shows the artifact, direction, and evidence state. Layer selection does not remove connections from the inspector.
limitations: These values record the implemented design. They do not give measured load time, interaction latency, or accessibility results.
SVG text uses map coordinates. The map transform changes the displayed text sizes.
Theme overrides can change colors. Runtime controls and previews must use the shared CSS variables.

narrative.northStar: A system map with source evidence for each flow
narrative.overview: The map shows system components and directed flows. Each card gives a component purpose. Each flow identifies an artifact. The inspector gives source evidence for the selected component or flow. Text view gives the same information as text. The design uses refined prototype revision 5. These specifications do not give measured performance or accessibility results.
rules: Use ASD-STE100 Issue 9 for all reader text, names, and sequences.
dos: Keep authored positions when the reader changes layers or views.
Keep component purposes visible beside their connections.
Keep all component connections in the inspector, with direction and evidence.
Keep finding identifiers exact. Separate authored claims from source facts.
Make selection, evidence, and sequence roles clear without motion.
donts: Do not restore the rejected operations-first atlas layout.
Do not show directional animation as recorded execution.
Do not hide missing evidence or classify a declared flow as observed without source support.
